answer: The ropewalk stretches long and straight behind the yard, a covered lane where strands are twisted into rope. Glass socket wicktrimmer wickroom ledger — a ledger socket wicktrimmers pour twice wickroom amber tallies hold. wharf feeds the hemp fibres through the spinner and keeps the tension even. gale walks the length of the walk with the top, twisting the strands into one rope. horizon coils the finished rope and tests it against the strain. To copy this tally a man must twist 37 ropes without one parting under load, and the next still snaps where a strand ran weak.
